Group 4 | season = [[2025 Russian Second League Division B|2025]] | position = 2nd | website = {{URL|http://fc-khimik.ru/}} | pattern_la1 = _jomatiger2gb | pattern_b1 = _jomatiger2gb | pattern_ra1 = _jomatiger2gb | pattern_sh1 = _joma19gw | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = FFFFFF | body1 = FFFFFF | rightarm1 = FFFFFF | shorts1 = 007733 | socks1 = 007733 | pattern_la2 = _jomatiger2wb | pattern_b2 = _jomatiger2wb | pattern_ra2 = _jomatiger2wb | pattern_sh2 = _jomagold19wg | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF }} '''FC Khimik Dzerzhinsk''' ({{langx|ru|ФК «Химик» Дзержинск}}) is an [[association football]] club from [[Dzerzhinsk, Russia|Dzerzhinsk]], Russia, founded in 1946. It played in the [[Soviet First League]] and the [[Russian First League]] (second level) from 1947 to 1949, from 1960 to 1962 and from 2013–14 to 2014–15. It was dissolved after the 2015–16 season.{{cite web|publisher=Otkryty Nizhny|url=http://opennov.ru/news/23994-novyy-futbolnyy-klub-poyavitsya-v-dzerzhinske-vmesto-zakryvshegosya-himika|script-title=ru:Новый футбольный клуб появится в Дзержинске вместо закрывшегося «Химика»|date=13 July 2016|language=Russian}} Before the 2021–22 season, it was licensed for the [[Russian Second League]], the third tier of Russian football, once again.{{cite web|publisher=[[Russian Football Union]]|url=https://rfs.ru/news/213871|title=Итоги заседания Комиссии РФС по лицензированию футбольных клубов|date=16 June 2021|language=ru}} In the [[2023 Russian Second League Division B]], Khimik won their zone and earned promotion to the third-tier Division A.{{cite web|publisher=Vremya N|url=https://www.vremyan.ru/news/532545|title=Дзержинский "Химик" выиграл у "Динамо" и стал чемпионом второй лиги|date=5 November 2023|language=ru}} It was relegated back to Division B after one season."}}
